what: Destination-staging transfer for cqc-care-home-deregistration: copy the five accepted cqc-chd-004 artifact files (artifact afe9ee203f302f3c, digests equal to the package MANIFEST.json) from private staging release 433536764 into the private dataset repository earino/cqc-care-home-deregistration draft release 433767120 (v2026.11), under the flat asset names the download helper restores. Each asset is verified against its recorded sha256 on arrival and against the server's own digest after upload; peak worker disk is one asset (13.2 MB total), so the bytes never pass through the coordinator. Asset ids were resolved by digest match through publish-dataset.py --stream-test, not hand-copied.
